# opsramp_resource_lookup (Data Source)

Checks if a resource exists given a query string. Returns `exists` and the first match `id`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `query` (String) Opaque query string appended to the API (e.g., `name=my-name&type=app`).

### Read-Only

- `exists` (Boolean) True if at least one resource matches.
- `id` (String) ID of the first matching resource (if any).



## Example Usage
```terraform
data "opsramp_resource_lookup" "on_prem" {
  query = "tag['application'] CONTAINS '${var.app_id}'AND nativeType IS NULL"
}
```
